description: This file defines an interface and a class implementing a durable set data structure with persistence and snapshot capabilities, part of the Orleans project.

classes.name: DurableSet<T>
classes.description: A durable, persistent implementation of a set that supports versioned log entries, snapshots, and state machine operations.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the state machine, clearing the current items and setting new storage.

methods.name: Apply
methods.description: Applies a log entry to modify the set's state based on command type.

methods.name: AppendEntries
methods.description: Method intended to append log entries, currently unimplemented.

methods.name: AppendSnapshot
methods.description: Appends a snapshot to the storage.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears the set and logs the clear command.

methods.name: Contains
methods.description: Checks if an item exists in the set.

methods.name: CopyTo
methods.description: Copies the set items to an array starting at a specified index.

methods.name: GetEnumerator
methods.description: Returns an enumerator for iterating over the set.

methods.name: Add
methods.description: Adds an item to the set and logs the operation.

methods.name: Remove
methods.description: Removes an item from the set and logs the operation.

methods.name: ApplyAdd
methods.description: Applies an add operation internally.

methods.name: ApplyRemove
methods.description: Applies a remove operation internally.

methods.name: ApplyClear
methods.description: Clears the items internally.

methods.name: DeepCopy
methods.description: Returns a deep copy of the set (not implemented).

methods.name: ExceptWith
methods.description: Removes all elements in the specified collection from the set.

methods.name: IsProperSubsetOf
methods.description: Checks if the set is a proper subset of another collection.

methods.name: IsProperSupersetOf
methods.description: Checks if the set is a proper superset of another collection.

methods.name: IsSubsetOf
methods.description: Checks if the set is a subset of another collection.

methods.name: IsSupersetOf
methods.description: Checks if the set is a superset of another collection.

methods.name: Overlaps
methods.description: Determines whether the set overlaps with another collection.

methods.name: SetEquals
methods.description: Determines whether the set is equal to another collection.

methods.name: IntersectorWith
methods.description: Modifies the set to contain only elements that are also in another collection.

methods.name: SymmetricExceptWith
methods.description: Modifies the set to contain only elements that are in either the set or the other collection but not in both.

methods.name: UnionWith
methods.description: Modifies the set to contain all elements that are in either the set or the specified collection.
